NUCLEAR PURE PLAY PODCAST | Mineralization is not a mine A promising drill result can tell you there’s uranium in the ground. But how much does it tell you about whether there’s a mine? In Episode 6 of Cameco’s Nuclear Pure Play Podcast, VP of Exploration Alex Aubin and VP of Investor Relations and Communications Cory Kos dig into the work that happens after discovery, from building confidence in a deposit to understanding the geology and reducing the uncertainty that shapes what comes next.
